# Remko Vermeulen

> VP & Head of Product — 15+ years building digital products across health, SaaS, and telco.

Remko Vermeulen is a senior product leader based in Europe. He has scaled products to 5.8M users, led product and design organisations of up to 90 people, and drove the product strategy that helped Koa Health raise $66M Series B funding. Currently VP & Head of Product at Toggl. He specialises in digital health, AI/ML product development, 0-to-1 product creation, and leading distributed product teams.

## Experience

- **Toggl** — VP & Head of Product (current). Restructured product, design and engineering teams at a profitable SaaS company, cutting costs by 26% while increasing output by implementing an AI-based user insights and prototyping flow. Drove a 94% increase in first-time activation by removing friction from the early user journey.
- **Koa Health** — CPO / VP Product. Co-founded and scaled a digital mental health company from 1 to 40 people, raising €66M and reaching 3M users. Built a portfolio of clinically validated products in partnership with the NHS, Harvard, and Janssen. Led Series B ($66M). Digital mental health.
- **Telefónica / O2** — Led UX, product and service design across 5 locations for Telefonica's global health and digital portfolio. Delivered a chronic disease service reducing mortality by 48%, Parkinson's voice detection at 78% precision, and pandemic prediction tools with WHO and Harvard.
- **Janssen / Johnson & Johnson** — Led product definition and clinical trial for a digital therapeutic companion to Spravato (esketamine) for treatment-resistant depression, developed in partnership with Janssen / Johnson & Johnson.

## Selected Projects

- **Toggl** — Restructured product, design and engineering teams at a profitable SaaS company, cutting costs by 26% while increasing output by implementing an AI-based user insights and prototyping flow. Drove a 94% increase in first-time activation. [Case study](https://remkovermeulen.com/case-study?id=35f76183-7377-81f2-9f5a-dbd1debf2fb1)
- **Koa Health** — Co-founded and scaled a digital mental health company from 1 to 40 people, raising €66M and reaching 3M users. Built a portfolio of clinically validated products in partnership with the NHS, Harvard, and Janssen. [Case study](https://remkovermeulen.com/case-study?id=35f76183-7377-8135-9dd1-d1b22dfa6da0)
- **SignAssist** — Led product end-to-end at a PropTech SaaS startup, improving unit economics from 162% to 21% CAC/LTV and growing active users by 87% through better onboarding and AI-powered document tooling. [Case study](https://remkovermeulen.com/case-study?id=35f76183-7377-816c-8a7f-e43d868da1c7)
- **Perspectives** — Led a digital CBT product from concept through clinical trial with MGH and Harvard, achieving 90% treatment response, 55% symptom reduction, and 95% cost reduction versus traditional therapy. [Case study](https://remkovermeulen.com/case-study?id=36076183-7377-812d-9aec-f4697182cf9d)
- **Johnson & Johnson** — Led product definition and clinical trial for a digital therapeutic companion to Spravato (esketamine) for treatment-resistant depression, developed in partnership with Janssen / Johnson & Johnson. [Case study](https://remkovermeulen.com/case-study?id=35f76183-7377-812e-89c0-f80d125d898b)
